newsitem.title: GREECE: Explosion rocks central Athens, TV says bomb.
newsitem.headline: Explosion rocks central Athens, TV says bomb.

text.p: A powerful explosion rocked central Athens on Tuesday but there were no immediate reports of casualties, police said.
Greek television reported that a bomb exploded at the entrance to the office of socialist parliamentary deputy Stelios Papathemelis, a former public order minister.
The private Mega television said the bomb caused heavy damage but no injuries. Another private channel showed fire engines arriving at the office building near the central Syndagma Square.
Television channels said an urban guerrilla group had warned of the bomb attack in telephone calls to Athens newspapers minutes before the explosion.
Greece's leftist urban guerrillas often target Greek politicians and businessmen in their bombing campaigns.
